# FacturXMetadata

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolved Factur-X / ZUGFeRD XMP metadata written into the document-level XMP packet under the `fx` namespace. Populated by [`applyFacturX`](apply-factur-x.md) from a [`FacturXProfile`](factur-x-profile.md); carried on `settings.facturX` and consumed by the XMP writer.

These are the four properties the Factur-X / ZUGFeRD 2.x technical specification requires: already-resolved strings, not the domain profile enum (the profile→level mapping lives in `facturXConformanceLevel`).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`conformanceLevel`](#conformancelevel): `fx:ConformanceLevel` — the profile name, e.g. `"EN 16931"`.
- [`documentFileName`](#documentfilename): `fx:DocumentFileName` — MUST match the embedded XML attachment's file name.
- [`documentType`](#documenttype): `fx:DocumentType` — normally `"INVOICE"` (also `"ORDER"` for Order-X).
- [`version`](#version): `fx:Version` — the Factur-X specification version, e.g. `"1.0"`.
